dimensions.name: Technical judgment
dimensions.reason: Pure ordered R0-R18 policy cannot authorize writes; ownership, query/snapshot binding, explicit host consent, exact EdDSA argument/tool admission, ledger generation, replay/revocation and independent durable receipt recovery are implemented and deeply tested. My current core replay passed 1,078 checks; card/API and bank suites exercise real fictional state and concurrency. Generic FLUJO remains separate. Broader joined/deployment and operational assurance across configurable native/direct/fleet paths remains bounded rather than whole-production accepted.

dimensions.name: AI engineering
dimensions.reason: Structured interpretation, bounded repair/fallback, actual two-role model tasks, trusted-fact enum advice, durable inquiries/events, original-run fleet recovery and independent review correlation are concrete. Native voice lacks bank access, gates current-utterance delegation, verifies canonical captions before PCM presentation and waits for exact device-drained UI ACKs. Latest audio artifacts match; my 107 voice tests and inquiry/fleet/API tests pass. The specialists demonstrate bounded advice selection, not broad autonomous investigation; the exact ten-team customer attempt failed before delegation. Physical hearing, unconstrained dialogue quality and full-fleet completion remain unproven; the ElevenLabs comparison is positioning, not a performance benchmark.

dimensions.name: Data engineering
dimensions.reason: Six-table bronze/silver/gold implements typing/contracts, deterministic dedup/upserts, quarantine reconciliation, lineage fingerprints, owner-valid serving buckets, single-writer locking, immutable snapshots and report completion before atomic CURRENT swap. Historical 5,899,720-row/4,390-object artifacts are detailed; my public fixture replay passes all seven reconciliation, isolation, late-correction, idempotency and old-snapshot invariants and current bank suite passes. S3 inventory/ETag freshness is bounded and atomic replacement does not establish crash durability or a multi-filesystem transaction.

dimensions.name: ML/evaluation
dimensions.reason: The team correctly rejects template-leaked/weak source labels, builds an inspectable TF-IDF/logistic router with train-only parameter selection, frozen separately AI-authored ES/PT diagnostic, keyword baseline, uncertainty and abstention analysis. My fixed replay reproduces 94/120 versus 70/120, paired gain 20 points with 10-30 point bootstrap interval, and human misses 3/30 reduced to 1/30 at the cost of 52/90 unnecessary handoffs. Luna artifacts independently reproduce 100 exact-correct/safe outputs and baseline ties, with only ten repeated request phrases. All router truth remains AI-proposed, eight audited labels are not human adjudication, and untouched/customer-dialogue evaluation and real traffic quality are missing.

dimensions.name: Data analytics
dimensions.reason: Data findings change owned grounding, merchant identification and ML decisions. Read-only metadata extraction, HMAC pseudonyms, explicit workflow-only denominators and separate validated current-host snapshots avoid confusing intent, intake, handoff and resolution. My replay passes all four analytics invariants; 34 host-outcome tests pass; independent operating calculations reproduce latency, tokens, baseline tie, routing burden and separate customer n=3/n=1 boundaries. Persisted cost/token coverage, lifetime/card-action attribution, repeat contacts, actual human pickup and ROI remain unavailable rather than inferred.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.finding: FLUJO generic main/default builds must remain general purpose, with banking source isolated in Savia/Banking MCP or the dedicated authorized branch; source preservation is not deployment acceptance.

The complete deterministic R0-R18 engine, owned reads, clarification, consent, verified receipts, restart recovery, idempotency and revocation form the submission foundation; teams and voice extend it.

defects_and_gaps.finding: The integrated fleet customer root encountered HTTP404 from a disabled provider workspace before delegation, producing no reviewed result. Exact 10x10 customer completion remains unqualified.

All 120 router labels are AI-proposed; the disclosed automated sample audit covers 8/120. Neither it nor the repetitive 100-case Luna fixture benchmark establishes human-validated customer quality or LLM advantage.

Original PT selected-fact and native unasked-delegation failures remain recorded. Post-fix fallback/native results have separate source scopes. Latest voice batch failed after successful ES and before a PT provider call; later PT-only continuation succeeded, without converting the original batch to a pass.

Exact transcript and PCM/sample receipt coherence does not align speech waveform with intended text or establish physical hearing. A clean even-length premature PCM completion cannot alone prove semantic narration completeness.

Persisted model cost/token coverage, exact workflow/action linkage, lifetime/card-block accounting, real resolution/human pickup, repeat contacts and sustained reliability are not measured. Current-slot and historical small-sample denominators are disclosed.

limitations: Repository-only review; no web, current public endpoint, live provider, actual deployment, other checkout or private raw dataset was checked.
Tests use generated fictional data and declared doubles; source checks do not prove production bank authorization, real money movement or real human pickup.
Full native/compiler/build acceptance, complete Windows/Linux workflow CI and the historical 104 upstream tests were not replayed. Only the copied generic retry smoke was independently executed.
Frontend node_modules was absent and no dependencies were installed, so UI test/build results were inspected through source and dated pinned receipts rather than independently rerun.
Current 183 runtime source Git blobs match the committed release map; this is local source congruence, not fresh live-image identity. Thirty-two working-byte differences are Windows CRLF only.

The original core receipt has one later changed bank reader and the publication receipt has a later regenerated flow manifest; historical counts were not transferred to whole current HEAD. A new core replay ran on current HEAD.
No audio listening or film playback was performed; local pitch/customer images were viewed. Audio checks prove byte/caption/sample coherence, not waveform semantics or physical hearing.
Router labels remain AI-authored, diagnostic balanced cases are not production prevalence, and the Luna workload has ten repeated phrases with varied facts and a perfect deterministic baseline.
Infrastructure reference-code, sandbox, direct Luna, two-reviewer customer, card-action and voice workloads are kept separate; no counts or latency denominators are pooled.
ElevenLabs facts are dated repository vendor claims; no matched head-to-head quality, latency, cost or competitive-superiority benchmark was independently verified.
Scores reflect practical declared hackathon scope; production-scale extensions are neither required as demonstrated production features nor credited as successful customer results.
